name: Park Jae-Hyun
bio:
Park Jae-Hyun's meticulous nature and sharp eye for detail led him to the heart of motorsport quality control. Growing up near the Korea International Circuit, he was captivated by the precision and engineering involved in racing. After graduating with a degree in mechanical engineering, he honed his skills in the automotive industry before transitioning to motorsport, eager to apply his knowledge in a high-stakes environment.

Jae-Hyun is driven by a relentless pursuit of perfection. He believes that even the smallest flaw can have significant consequences on the track. He fosters a culture of continuous improvement within his team, encouraging them to challenge existing processes and strive for innovation. His ability to identify and address potential issues before they escalate makes him a valuable asset to EKS JC. He is known for his knack for spotting seemingly minor design flaws that could create large problems on the track, and is never afraid to point out when something is not up to standard.

His innovative problem-solving, combined with his background in the automotive sector, makes Park Jae-Hyun a uniquely effective quality control specialist. He approaches every challenge with a blend of technical expertise and a strong sense of responsibility, ensuring that EKS JC's cars are built to the highest standards.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly parted to the side with a slight wave.
physical.description: He has a serious, focused expression, and a lean build.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down observations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen on the table when deep in thought.
Insists on performing a final visual inspection of every component before it's installed.
